coverage.note: Representative sample area around Hussain Sagar / Banjara Hills used for Phase 2 validation. This is a subset of the approved city window — NOT the full urban coverage area and NOT the GHMC boundary.

sources.name: AWS Terrain Tiles (Terrarium encoding), zoom 12
sources.license: Public domain (SRTM / USGS / NASA via Mapzen)
sources.attribution: Elevation: NASA SRTM / USGS via Mapzen Terrarium tiles

terrain.storage: real metres; exaggeration applied at runtime (cityConfig.terrainExaggeration)

simplification.note: conservative; footprints and junction shapes preserved

heightEstimation.method: OSM height tag (plausibility-checked against building:levels) > building:levels x 3.2 m + 1.2 > deterministic estimate from mapped building type, else OSM way id + footprint area
heightEstimation.note: Estimated heights are approximations, NOT surveyed data. Verified heights cover a small fraction of buildings.

landmarks.definition: Named OSM buildings with a city-scale use category (hotel, mall, hospital, government, place of worship, station, cinema, bank)
landmarks.note: Landmark flag marks recognisable geography; it does not alter heights.
